verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official SDK is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence shows only raw API reference pages (custom integration push APIs, framework health/vendor data APIs) and an agent-skills GitHub repo. Nothing documents an official client SDK in any language, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Raw APIs and agent skills are adjacent building blocks, not SDKs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
